Below is a complete Markdown prompt/specification that you can paste directly into Google Gemini AI Studio (Build App).

It includes:

✅ Your Week 5 workout plan (Mon–Fri)

✅ Your stretching routines

✅ Mobile-first PWA UI

✅ Google Sheets backend (Apps Script)

✅ Gemini API weekly analysis (numeric, factual)

✅ Vercel + Vite deployment fix (API_KEY handling)

✅ Data schema for progress tracking

✅ Weekly analysis logic

✅ Environment variable handling

✅ Fully compatible with Vercel + Vite + PWA

You can copy everything below as-is.

📄 COMPLETE MARKDOWN PROMPT FOR GEMINI AI STUDIO
# 🏋️ Gym Workout Tracker & AI Progress Analysis PWA

## 🎯 Goal
Create a **mobile-first Progressive Web App (PWA)** for personal gym tracking and analysis.

The app will:
- Show a structured **weekly workout plan (Mon–Fri)**
- Show corresponding **stretch routines**
- Allow daily logging of:
  - Exercise name
  - Weight used per set
  - Reps per set
  - Notes (optional)
- Save all workout logs to a **Google Sheet backend (Apps Script)**
- Generate **weekly numerical progress analysis** using Gemini API
- Save weekly analysis back to Google Sheet
- Display weekly analysis inside the app

The app is for **single-user personal use only**.

---

## 🧱 Tech Stack
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite
- UI: Mobile-first responsive design (Tailwind or simple CSS)
- Backend: Google Sheets via Google Apps Script (.gs code)
- AI: Google Gemini API
- Deployment: Vercel
- PWA: Offline support, installable on phone

---

## ⚙️ Vercel Deployment Configuration (IMPORTANT)

### vite.config.ts
Ensure environment variable mapping:

```ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

export default defineConfig({
  define: {
    'process.env.API_KEY': JSON.stringify(process.env.API_KEY)
  }
});

package.json

Build command must be compatible with Vercel:

{
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc && vite build",
    "dev": "vite"
  }
}


Gemini API Key will be stored in Vercel Environment Variable:

API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key_here


Do NOT hardcode API key in source.

📊 Google Sheets Backend
Sheet Tabs:

WorkoutLogs

WeeklyAnalysis

🗂 Data Schema (WorkoutLogs)
Date	Day	MuscleGroup	Exercise	SetNumber	WeightKg	Reps	Notes

Example:

2026-02-04 | Monday | Chest | Incline Press | 1 | 7.5 | 10 | Felt good

🧠 Data Schema (WeeklyAnalysis)
WeekNumber	MuscleGroup	TotalVolume	AvgWeight	MaxWeight	TotalSets	Summary

Summary must be numerical and factual, not motivational text.

Example Summary:

Chest volume increased from 420kg to 480kg (+14.2%)
Average reps stable at 10.2
Max weight improved from 15kg to 17.5kg

🤖 Gemini AI Weekly Analysis Rules

The AI must compute:

Total volume per muscle group = sum(weight × reps × sets)

Compare current week vs previous week

Calculate:

% increase or decrease

Max weight improvement

Set consistency

Output only concrete metrics

No generic motivational phrases

Store result into Google Sheet (WeeklyAnalysis tab)

Prompt format example:

Analyze this week's workout data vs last week and return:
- Total volume change (%)
- Max weight change
- Avg reps change
- Muscle groups improved or declined

📅 WEEKLY WORKOUT PLAN (Mon–Fri)
🟥 MONDAY – Chest + Triceps

Barbell Chest Press – 3×8–10

Incline Chest Press – 3×10

Decline Press or Chest Press Machine – 3×10

Pec Fly Machine – 3×12

Triceps Pushdown – 3×12

Overhead Triceps Extension – 3×10

Incline Push-ups – 40–50 reps total

🟩 TUESDAY – Back + Biceps

Seated Cable Row – 3×10–12

One-arm DB Row – 3×10 each side

Face Pulls – 3×15

Barbell/DB Curl – 3×10

🟦 WEDNESDAY – Legs

🧘 Stretching Routines (Post Workout)
Chest + Triceps Day

Chest wall stretch – 30s each side

Overhead triceps stretch – 30s each arm

Cross-body shoulder stretch – 30s each

Chest opener – 45s

Child’s pose – 45s

Friday Upper Body

Chest wall stretch

Overhead lat stretch

Cross-body shoulder stretch

📱 UI Requirements

Mobile-first layout

Tabs:

Workout Plan

Log Workout

Weekly Analysis

History

Large buttons

Simple forms for sets & reps

Charts (weekly volume per muscle group)

PWA installable on phone

🔐 Security

API key stored in Vercel environment variable

Google Sheets used as private backend

No authentication required (single user)

📈 Weekly Analysis Display

Show:

Volume per muscle group

% change vs last week

Max weight improvement

Sets completed

Numerical trend graphs

Example:

Chest: +12.4% volume
Back: +8.1%
Legs: -2.3% (fatigue)

✅ Final Deliverables

Vite + React project

PWA enabled

Google Apps Script backend code

Gemini API integration

Vercel deployable project

Mobile responsive UI

Weekly numerical analysis stored in Google Sheets

Build this as a complete working application ready to deploy on Vercel.


---

If you want, next I can help you with:
✅ A **separate Gemini prompt just for Google Apps Script (.gs backend)**  
✅ A **wireframe UI layout (mobile screens)**  
✅ A **data validation logic (no wrong reps/weights)**  
✅ A **step-by-step Vercel deploy guide**  
✅ A **Gemini API analysis prompt only (standalone)**  

Just say which one you want:
**1) Apps Script backend prompt  
2) UI wireframe  
3) Deployment guide  
4) Gemini analysis prompt

**Outlining System Architecture**

I'm solidifying the technical architecture now. The frontend will be React 18+ with TypeScript, styled using Tailwind. Data will persist in Google Sheets, accessed via Apps Script. I'm now zeroing in on integrating the various services. I'm focusing on providing the user with GAS code and setup instructions, since I can't deploy it for them. I'm now sketching the core code structure mentally. I'm focusing on the data structure for workout plans which needs to link days, muscle groups, and exercises. I'm also preparing to integrate Gemini, needing to secure the API key via `process.env`. Dark mode will be key for gym-goers, with large buttons and a sticky bottom nav for easy mobile use. The implementation plan has begun, with clear initial steps.


**Clarifying GAS Integration**

I'm now clarifying the Google Apps Script integration strategy. I'll include the GAS code as a separate file, clearly labeled, for user copy-pasting. I'm focusing the React app's code.

I've self-corrected the approach, deciding to use a Google Apps Script Web App as a proxy for Google Sheets API interactions; it's simpler and handles CORS. For the PWA, I'm going to implement a `manifest.json` file and a service worker registration to ensure functionality. I will be sure to use the correct Gemini model for optimal text analysis.


**Defining the System Files**

I am now focusing on the specific file structure for the app's code. I've broken down each part into the relevant file: `metadata.json`, `index.html`, `index.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `types.ts`, `constants.ts`, `services/sheetService.ts`, `services/geminiService.ts`, and `vite.config.ts`. The crucial `google-apps-script.js` file will be provided separately for the user. I'm confirming that the analysis feature will be built to fetch logs, format prompts, send them to Gemini, and display results. I plan to use `recharts` for volume trends. I'm now nailing down the setup process. I'll provide clear instructions for the GAS URL, either through an environment variable or, preferably, a user input field. I'm going to lean towards the user input field for immediate use. I'm confirming that the user will be clearly instructed on where to add the GAS URL in the frontend. I will include the GAS code.
